record.question: The Nurse giving oxygen therapy should know that it has to be humidified because:
options: Oxygen is a dry gas and thickens the mucus
Oxygen gets cleaned of pathogens by humidification
Oxygen gets easily absorbed because humidification adds H-ion to it
record.explanation: Answer B: Oxygen is a dry gas and thickens the mucus. Oxygen is a dry medical gas; humidification may help prevent drying and thickening of airway secretions, particularly with higher flows or specific indications. Source/context note: Routine humidification is not required for every low-flow oxygen patient; indication depends on flow and protocol. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK568801/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
